searchText: Christine Kim's CL call notes: https://twitter.com/christine_dkim/status/1522256793321103360 I'm not an opponent of semi-altruistic solutions - in practice, they work well enough as long as there is a legitimate interest in the data, which in this case I believe there might be - I'm curious though if there's been any discussion as to what even an altrustic solution would look like - the nodes storing the data need to coordinate similar to how attestations are disseminated in a two-level aggregation setup - ie if nobody is designated to store the data, nobody will _for sure_ 🙂 I wrote up some quick notes on the landscape here. Not necessarily comprehensive, but a brain dump of the requirements and solution avenues I'm aware of https://notes.ethereum.org/GXEonbG3SQayOfsZ91GJ6Q?view
